name: Volt
look: Brawler android with neon-blue electric gauntlets and a cracked chrome faceplate.
quip: Cracked his faceplate punching a vending machine. It still owes him a soda.

name: Fang
look: Chrome cyber-wolf with glowing pink fangs.
quip: Good boy. Bites anyway.

name: Goliath
look: Squat walker mech with orange vents and a heavy arm cannon.
quip: Short, loud, and absolutely not compensating for anything.

name: Razor
look: Samurai android with a violet hardlight katana and a split visor.
quip: Split his own visor showing off. Calls it a style choice.

name: Stinger
look: Chrome cyber-scorpion with a dripping green neon tail.
quip: The green drip is venom. Probably. Don't lick it.

name: Sentry
look: Tripod turret drone with a red scanning eye and twin barrels.
quip: Three legs, two barrels, zero chill.

name: Hex
look: Slim hacker android surrounded by floating holo keyboards.
quip: Types 400 words a minute. All of them are insults.

name: Mantis
look: Chrome praying mantis with teal blade arms.
quip: Prays before every fight. Mostly that you hold still.

name: Rook
look: Boxy walker tank with a hazard-striped cannon.
quip: Moves in straight lines only. Refuses to explain why.

name: Wirelash
look: Scrapyard android whose arm unspools into a sparking cable whip.
quip: Made entirely of extension cords and bad decisions.

name: Raptor
look: Cyber-hawk with glowing amber wings.
quip: Screams like an eagle. Is legally a hawk.

name: Crusher
look: Heavy cargo-loader mech with giant hydraulic fists and blue warning lights.
quip: Was hired to lift crates. Now lifts people. Same pay.

name: Nyx
look: Stealth android whose plating bends light.
quip: You won't see him coming. He won't see you leaving either.

name: Mongoose
look: Lightning-fast cyber-mongoose with amber reflex sensors.
quip: Has never lost a staring contest. Or blinked.

name: Harvester
look: Farm combine mech with glowing lime thresher blades.
quip: Retired from farming. The crops know why.

name: Blaze
look: Brawler android with plasma-flame fists and vented shoulders.
quip: Has never once held a cold drink.

name: Narwhal
look: Hovering cyber-narwhal with a frosted crystal tusk.
quip: The unicorn of the sea, now with a frost setting.

name: Siphon
look: Spindly mech that plugs cables into its targets.
quip: Your battery's on 1%? That was him.

name: Ronin
look: Battered swordsman android with a red neon tanto.
quip: No master, no shop, no warranty.

name: Viper
look: Cyber-cobra with a hood made of light panels.
quip: Hood lights up like a billboard. Subtle, it is not.

name: Juggernaut
look: Hulking siege mech that never stops walking.
quip: Doesn't know how to stop. Literally. The brakes are missing.

name: Glitch
look: Flickering android that skips frames when it moves.
quip: Lags in real life. Somehow still wins.

name: Rhino
look: Armored cyber-rhino with a chrome drill horn.
quip: Horn upgraded to a drill. Doorbells are a thing of the past.

name: Scout
look: Recon drone with a sweeping blue laser.
quip: Points a laser at you. Then his friends show up.

name: Cipher
look: Codebreaker android with a spinning cipher-wheel face.
quip: Spins its own face to think. It's a lot.

name: Arachne
look: Mechanical spider spinning glowing violet webs.
quip: Eight legs, glowing webs, ruins every dinner party.

name: Gyro
look: Gyrocopter mech with spinning saw rotors.
quip: Flies with saws. The neighbors have filed complaints.

name: Bounty
look: Hunter android in a long coat with a neon revolver arm.
quip: Wanted: Dead or Alive. Accepts both, prefers whichever's quicker.

name: Shark
look: Cyber-shark that swims through the air on hover fins.
quip: Hates water. Loves you.

name: Forge
look: Foundry mech with a glowing molten core.
quip: Runs hot. Bring oven mitts to the handshake.

name: Spike
look: Brawler android covered in chrome spikes.
quip: Cannot be hugged. Has tried.

name: Silverback
look: Chrome gorilla with glowing blue knuckles.
quip: Chest beat registers on seismographs.

name: Burrower
look: Mining mech with a massive spiral drill.
quip: Arrives from below. Leaves a sinkhole and a bad review.

name: Echo
look: Android with speaker cones built into its shoulders.
quip: Echo. Echo. Echo. She won't stop.

name: Panther
look: Sleek black cyber-panther with violet eyes.
quip: A cat in every way. Knocks your stuff off tables at 90 mph.

name: Mortar
look: Artillery walker with stubby launch tubes.
quip: Can't aim. Doesn't need to.

name: Rivet
look: Dockworker android with a hydraulic wrench arm.
quip: Clocked in for overtime. Never clocked out.

name: Croc
look: Swamp cyber-croc with a lime neon jaw.
quip: Smiles a lot. That's the problem.

name: Bastion
look: Fortress mech with fold-out armor walls.
quip: A building with legs and anger issues.

name: Vandal
look: Android with spray-nozzle hands that shoot blinding neon paint.
quip: Every wall is a canvas. Every face too.

name: Hornet
look: Fist-sized robo-hornet with a plasma stinger.
quip: Fist-sized. Somehow that's worse.

name: Magnus
look: Junkyard crane mech with a giant magnet.
quip: Your belt buckle is now his belt buckle.

name: Phantom
look: Hologram android that is barely there.
quip: Barely there. Still shows up to fights, technically.

name: Vesper
look: Cyber-bat that maps the arena with pink sonar.
quip: Sees with sound. Screams with purpose.

name: Buzzsaw
look: Scrap mech with a spinning buzzsaw arm.
quip: Built from scrap. Turns things back into scrap.

name: Brick
look: Huge bouncer android with slab-like chrome forearms.
quip: Bouncer. Your name is not on the list.

name: Boar
look: Chrome boar with glowing red tusks.
quip: Doesn't do turns. Only forward.

name: Skyburst
look: Jetpack mech that rains micro-missiles.
quip: Flies on a jetpack held together with tape and hope.

name: Shiv
look: Small scavenger android with twin hardlight knives.
quip: Small. Stabby. Sincerely sorry.

name: Kraken
look: Neon octopus that sprays glowing ink.
quip: Eight arms, all of them slapping.

name: Welder
look: Repair bot with a white-hot welding arm.
quip: Fixes friends. Melts enemies. Same tool.

name: Neon
look: Android whose glowing circuit lines pulse when it fights.
quip: Lights up when angry. Visible from orbit most days.

name: Hyena
look: Laughing cyber-hyena with a cracked amber visor.
quip: Laughs at every joke. Especially the ones you didn't make.

name: Hive
look: Cloud of tiny worker drones moving as one.
quip: A thousand drones and one shared opinion.

name: Static
look: Android that stores lightning in coils down its back.
quip: Pet him once and your hair stands up for a week.

name: Grizzly
look: Massive cyber-bear with exhaust pipes on its back.
quip: Bear hugs are not a gesture. They're a move.

name: Hoist
look: Construction crane mech with a swinging hook.
quip: Picks you up. Drops you off. Not at your stop.

name: Ember
look: Dancer android with molten-glow legs.
quip: Dances like the floor is lava, because it is now.

name: Komodo
look: Cyber-lizard dripping green static.
quip: One lick and your firmware is never the same.

name: Watchtower
look: Tall tower mech with a blinding spotlight head.
quip: Shines a light in your face and asks where you were Tuesday.

name: Jackal
look: Gang-leader android with a jackal-shaped chrome head.
quip: Runs a gang of three. Two are pipes.

name: Moth
look: Giant cyber-moth drawn to neon signs.
quip: Will abandon any fight for a nice neon sign.

name: Dozer
look: Bulldozer mech with a scarred chrome blade.
quip: Ask him to move. He'll move you.

name: Monk
look: Monk android wrapped in a glowing data-bead necklace.
quip: Achieved inner peace. Uses it to punch harder.

name: Vixen
look: Two-tailed cyber-fox with pink fire tips.
quip: Two tails, both on fire, zero regrets.

name: Overclock
look: Overclocked mech venting red steam.
quip: Runs at 300%. Warranty voided on day one.

name: Riot
look: Riot-control android with a hardlight shield.
quip: Brought a shield to a party. Wasn't invited back.

name: Scarab
look: Armored beetle with an oil-slick teal shell.
quip: Shell looks like an oil spill. Personality too.

name: Lancer
look: Jousting mech with a violet plasma lance.
quip: Jousting is dead. Nobody told him.

name: Lotus
look: Martial-arts android whose kicks leave pink light petals.
quip: Kicks so pretty you'll forget it hurt. It still hurt.

name: Crow
look: Cyber-crow with a cracked camera eye.
quip: Steals shiny things. You are slightly shiny.

name: Railer
look: Sniper mech with a long rail cannon.
quip: Shoots you from three districts away, then texts "gg".

name: Gunner
look: Mercenary android with a smoking neon rifle arm.
quip: Hasn't cooled his rifle since the last update.

name: Hare
look: Speedy cyber-hare with spring-loaded legs.
quip: Hops into combat. Burrows out of responsibility.

name: Shredder
look: Recycling mech with shredder jaws.
quip: Reduce. Reuse. Ruin.

name: Drifter
look: Racer android with wheel hubs in its legs and a chain fist.
quip: Never turns. Just slides sideways and hopes.

name: Eel
look: Electric eel crackling with cyan current.
quip: Swims through power lines for fun.

name: Pylon
look: Walking power pylon crackling with arcs.
quip: Do not touch. Seriously. Read the sign.

name: Siren
look: Android with a resonator throat that cracks glass.
quip: Hit one high note. Lost three windows and a friend.

name: Ram
look: Chrome ram with spiraling neon horns.
quip: Solves every problem with his forehead.

name: Quake
look: Squat mech with piston-driven fists.
quip: Every step is a 4.2 on the Richter scale.

name: Warden
look: Guard android with magnetic shackle hands.
quip: You have the right to remain shocked.

name: Piranha
look: Swarm of flying robo-piranhas.
quip: Individually adorable. Collectively a blender.

name: Cyclone
look: Turbine mech that whips up neon wind.
quip: Bad hair day guaranteed.

name: Dynamo
look: Power-plant android with spinning turbine gauntlets.
quip: Powers a whole block. Charges you rent.

name: Mammoth
look: Frozen cyber-mammoth with glowing ice tusks.
quip: Thawed out last Tuesday. Still grumpy about it.

name: Chopper
look: Attack-helicopter mech with twin rotors.
quip: Two rotors means twice the loud.

name: Rogue
look: Thief android that fights from inside a cloud of neon smoke.
quip: Fights inside a smoke cloud. Nobody's sure he's actually there.

name: Sabre
look: Sabertooth cyber-cat with amber plasma fangs.
quip: Teeth sized for a bigger cat. Doesn't care.

name: Crawler
look: Six-legged crawler mech built for climbing walls.
quip: Climbs walls, ceilings and your nerves.

name: Vanta
look: Martial-arts android in light-eating black plating with a blue edge.
quip: Absorbs light, sound and criticism.

name: Basilisk
look: Chrome serpent whose stare freezes circuits solid.
quip: Don't make eye contact. Seriously, look away.

name: Warlord
look: Command mech that calls down satellite strikes.
quip: Doesn't fight. Calls in a favor from space.

name: Shogun
look: Warlord android with a twin-bladed hardlight naginata.
quip: Two blades on one stick, because one blade is for amateurs.

name: Chimera
look: Three-headed cyber-beast, each head a different neon color.
quip: Three heads, one stomach, constant arguments.

name: Colossus
look: Towering mech that blocks out the city lights.
quip: Blocks out the sun. Doesn't apologize.

name: Specter
look: Spy android that phases through walls in a shimmer of static.
quip: Phases through walls. Still uses doors to be polite.

name: Wyvern
look: Small cyber-dragon with green plasma in its throat.
quip: Small dragon, huge attitude, terrible breath.

name: Valkyrie
look: Winged combat mech that dives from the sky.
quip: Dives from the clouds. Lands on you specifically.

name: Overdrive
look: Racer android with turbo-boosted legs.
quip: Zero to sixty before you finish blinking.

name: Manticore
look: Lion-bodied cyber-beast with a scorpion tail.
quip: A lion that said yes to every upgrade.

name: Reactor
look: Walking power core leaking lime radiation.
quip: Glows lime. Should not be hugged.

name: Prism
look: Crystal-bodied android that splits light into rainbow blades.
quip: Turns a flashlight into a rainbow of pain.

name: Thunderhide
look: Armored cyber-bison with lightning arcing between its horns.
quip: Charges on his own lightning. Never pays the bill.

name: Hellfire
look: Flamethrower tank mech with glowing fuel tanks.
quip: Sees a problem, sets it on fire.

name: Paragon
look: Golden android with a sun reactor in its chest.
quip: Has a sun in his chest. Never needs a nightlight.

name: Leviathan
look: Colossal cyber-sea-serpent from the flooded districts.
quip: Floods your district. Asks why you're wet.

name: Dreadnought
look: Flying battleship mech bristling with cannons.
quip: A battleship that learned to fly. Nobody stopped it.

name: Nightblade
look: Assassin android whose blade swallows light.
quip: His sword eats light. Hates birthday candles.

name: Phoenix
look: Firebird made of burning neon.
quip: Dies, comes back, does it again. Show-off.

name: Omega
look: AI war machine with one all-seeing lens.
quip: One eye, all-seeing. Saw what you did.

name: Sovereign
look: Ruler android of the neon city, crowned in hardlight.
quip: Rules the neon city. The crown is mostly for show.

name: Apex
look: Ancient alpha predator rebuilt in chrome.
quip: At the top of the food chain. Ate the rest of the chain.

name: Genesis
look: Self-building mech that grows new parts mid-fight.
quip: Builds itself mid-fight. Never finishes. Always upgrading.

name: Rune
look: Chrome android sorcerer in an armoured coat, violet rune circles spinning around both hands.
quip: Read the manual. Then rewrote it in ancient runes.

name: Wisp
look: A three-tailed fox made of living teal spirit-flame.
quip: Follow the light. It's probably fine.

name: Halo
look: Floating crystal construct with a golden halo and healing light in its hands.
quip: Turns you off and on again. Works every time.

name: Glyph
look: Matte-black android scribe covered in glowing scarlet glyph tattoos, writing spells in the air with a stylus finger.
quip: Has terrible handwriting. The spells work anyway.

name: Moonhare
look: A hare made of silver moonlight with crescent-moon ears and drifting lilac motes.
quip: Only comes out at night. Mostly to steal your carrots.

name: Lantern
look: Small floating paper-lantern bot with a crimson shell, gold tassels and a soft glowing heart.
quip: Lights the way home. Will not stop talking about it.

name: Hexcoil
look: Warlock android wound in serpentine copper coils that spit acid-green hexfire.
quip: Curses you, then apologises. Then curses you again.

name: Emberkoi
look: A pair of koi fish made of tangerine-gold flame, swimming through the air in a loop.
quip: Two fish, one brain cell, infinite swagger.

name: Bloom
look: Flower construct of glowing spring-green leaves with pink blossoms opening across its body.
quip: Heals you with petals. Mildly allergic to itself.

name: Rime
look: Frost-mage android with crystalline ice-blue armour and snowflake sigils orbiting its head.
quip: Cool under pressure. And everywhere else.

name: Wraithhound
look: Lean hound of ghost-green fire with a black smoke body and hollow glowing eyes.
quip: Fetches souls. Will not fetch sticks.

name: Chime
look: Floating wind-chime construct of hanging silver bells that ripple sky-blue sound waves.
quip: Heals with music. Only knows one song.

name: Tome
look: Librarian android with emerald plating, reading from a floating cream-paged spellbook that glows.
quip: Spoilers are a spell. A very evil one.

name: Nocturne
look: Great owl made of midnight-blue night sky, its feathers dotted with constellations.
quip: Asks 'who' a lot. Already knows the answer.

name: Tide
look: Flowing water construct shaped like a fountain, deep ocean blue with seafoam crests.
quip: Go with the flow. Or get washed away. Your call.

name: Tempest
look: Storm-caller android in a navy cloak, holding a floating orb of electric-yellow lightning.
quip: Brings an umbrella to every fight. For you.

name: Glimmerstag
look: Stag spirit with a pearl-white glowing body and branching antlers of peach-coral crystal.
quip: Majestic until it gets its antlers stuck in a doorway.

name: Vital
look: Rounded white medical drone with a neon-red cross visor and heartbeat lights pulsing down its arms.
quip: Your vitals are fine. Your choices are not.

name: Mirage
look: Desert illusionist android with sand-gold plates, flickering turquoise mirror-copies of itself around it.
quip: Which one is the real one? Not that one.

name: Mistwyrm
look: Small eel-like dragon made of swirling lavender mist with mint-green glowing whiskers.
quip: Mostly fog. Partly attitude.

name: Geode
look: Stocky slate-grey rock golem split open to show glowing citrine crystals inside.
quip: Hard on the outside. Also hard on the inside.

name: Sigil
look: Android with a hexagonal lens in its chest projecting spinning magenta sigils with teal edges.
quip: Signs everything with a magic circle. Including takeout orders.

name: Flutter
look: A swirling swarm of iridescent glass butterflies that catch and split the light.
quip: Beautiful, fragile and absolutely furious.

name: Plume
look: Floating construct of layered white feathers around a cobalt-blue light ring.
quip: Softest healer in the game. Sheds everywhere.

name: Origami
look: Slim android whose body folds like paper, conjuring a flock of rose-pink paper cranes.
quip: Paper cuts, but make it magic.

name: Drift
look: Floating jellyfish spirit with an aqua bell and long hot-pink bioluminescent tendrils.
quip: No brain, no heart, no problem.

name: Wick
look: Small ivory candle golem with a calm cyan flame for a head and melted-wax drips.
quip: Burns the midnight oil. Also itself.

name: Flask
look: Alchemist android with a bandolier of bubbling lime and purple potion vials.
quip: Labels are for people who want to live.

name: Totem
look: Big bear spirit of amber light, carved with glowing patterns like a living totem pole.
quip: Hugs are free. Escaping costs extra.

name: Mender
look: Spider-like bronze repair drone whose eight arms stitch wounds closed with glowing teal thread.
quip: Fixes anything. Bills you in compliments.

name: Archon
look: Tall high-mage android with a crown of six spellbooks orbiting its head.
quip: Has read every book. Has opinions about all of them.

name: Thunderbird
look: Huge bird of storm light with lightning crackling along violet-white wings.
quip: Every flap is a weather warning.

name: Sanctum
look: Walking shrine construct of white marble with a glowing jade healing pool on its back.
quip: Open 24/7. No appointment needed.

name: Hexblade
look: Spellsword android in black plate with a rune-etched blade dripping blood-red void magic.
quip: The sword talks. Mostly trash.

name: Aurora
look: A sky whale made of aurora borealis, its body rippling green, pink and purple light.
quip: Hums in frequencies only dogs and wizards hear.

name: Choir
look: Ring of floating pearl crystal tuning forks that hum healing harmonies in prismatic light.
quip: Practises 24 hours a day. Neighbours hate it.

name: Chronos
look: Time-mage android with a clockwork halo and glowing aquamarine sand falling through an hourglass chest.
quip: Always on time. Usually yesterday's.

name: Solmane
look: Lion spirit with a mane of erupting solar flares and white-hot eyes.
quip: King of the jungle. And the sun. Ask him.

name: Lifeline
look: Slim charcoal android surgeon with six coral-light arms and a halo of tiny med-drones.
quip: Steady hands. All six of them.

name: Voidweaver
look: Obsidian android sorceress weaving a tiny ultraviolet black hole between her hands.
quip: Knits with gravity. Your scarf is now a star.

name: Starwyrm
look: Serpent dragon made of a living galaxy, gold constellations tracing its cosmic-teal body.
quip: Was a zodiac sign once. Got bored.

name: Petalcore
look: Giant mechanical lotus of rose-gold petals that unfold to pour out jade healing light.
quip: Opens up slowly. Like your friend who does therapy.

name: Omnis
look: The first android to learn magic: a towering platinum sorcerer crowned by orbiting rune planets of every colour.
quip: Invented magic. Wants royalties.

name: Dawnbringer
look: Colossal stag-dragon made of sunrise light, sky-orange to pink, trailing a dawn sky behind it.
quip: Hits snooze for no one.

name: Eternity
look: Vast floating crystal heart ringed by spinning halos that throw full-spectrum healing light.
quip: Has been around forever. Still has not seen it all.

name: Valor
look: Android samurai general in midnight-navy armour, twin hardlight katanas, a cape trailing falling stars.
quip: Undefeated in duels. Several losses to stairs.

name: Overlord
look: Towering gladiator champion android in gunmetal armour with molten bronze-gold seams and wrecking-ball fists.
quip: Retired from the arena. The arena did not retire from him.

name: Fenrir
look: Giant mechanical wolf of frosted chrome, ice crystals growing from its back, breathing blue frost.
quip: Was told to sit. Ate the instructions.

name: Tyrannos
look: Mechanical tyrannosaurus king in black chrome with a crown of toxic-lime neon spikes.
quip: Short arms. Long reach.

name: Atlas
look: Mountain-sized titan mech carrying a glowing ringed planet on its shoulders.
quip: Carries the world. Still asks for help with groceries.

name: Zenith
look: Sleek silver-white sky-fortress mech, half jet fighter, half walking fortress, red running lights.
quip: Peaked early. Stayed there.

name: Grimoire
look: Android golem whose body is a giant open spellbook, pages fanned into armour, violet runes flying off.
quip: Spoiler: everyone loses.

name: Paradox
look: Slender android time-sorceress with floating clock-rune rings and a cracked hourglass heart.
quip: Already won this fight. Doing it again for fun.

name: Celestia
look: Huge celestial whale of living starlight and nebula, constellations across its body.
quip: Sings to the stars. The stars sing back, badly.

name: Ifrit
look: Fire djinn of living flame and black smoke with a molten-gold mask for a face.
quip: Grants wishes. Mostly for more fire.

name: Seraph
look: Six-winged angelic healer construct of white porcelain and pale-gold light, faceless halo visor.
quip: Watches over everyone. Judges a little.

name: Gaia
look: World-tree healer construct of crystal and glowing vines, a leaf-canopy crown and a faceless crystal mask.
quip: Plants one seed. Grows a forest. Nobody asked.

name: Bladestorm
look: Duelist android with six hardlight blades orbiting it.
quip: Brought six swords to a knife fight.

name: Ironclad
look: Armoured knight android behind a tower shield of neon glass.
quip: Hasn't taken a hit in years. Dodges conversations too.

name: Ghostwire
look: Assassin android dissolving into streams of green code.
quip: You won't see him coming. Or leaving.

name: Hydra
look: Three-headed mechanical serpent in violet chrome.
quip: Three heads, zero agreement.

name: Stormclaw
look: Electric chrome tiger crackling with yellow lightning.
quip: Purrs at 10,000 volts.

name: Sandscorch
look: Giant mechanical desert scorpion with an amber plasma stinger.
quip: Has a tail for every occasion.

name: Ravager
look: Eight-legged spider-tank mech with red sensor eyes.
quip: Eight legs, zero chill.

name: Aegis
look: Floating fortress drone ringed with hex-light shields.
quip: Blocks everything. Including your calls.

name: Havoc
look: Heavy artillery walker with twin yellow-hot cannons.
quip: Aims for subtle. Hits the whole block.

name: Spellforge
look: Blacksmith android hammering molten orange runes into shape.
quip: Forges spells. Also toasts sandwiches.

name: Nebulon
look: Star-mage android wrapped in a cloak full of galaxies.
quip: Has a cloak full of stars. Still loses keys.

name: Hexqueen
look: Witch-queen android with a crown of floating magenta hexes.
quip: Rules by curse. Mostly paperwork.

name: Kitsune
look: Nine-tailed fox made of amber spirit light.
quip: Nine tails. Nine excuses.

name: Glacia
look: Phoenix made of living ice crystals and pale blue light.
quip: Cool under pressure. Freezing, actually.

name: Raiju
look: Lightning beast of pure yellow electricity with a thundercloud mane.
quip: Naps in thunderclouds. Doesn't share.

name: Lumina
look: Floating crystal chandelier construct pouring warm healing light.
quip: Lights up every room. And the bill.

name: Mendforge
look: Clockwork medic beetle construct with glowing green repair arms.
quip: Fixes anything. Except your attitude.

name: Coralheart
look: Reef construct of pink coral and glowing sea light.
quip: Sensitive to temperature. And criticism.

name: Deadeye
look: Sniper android with a long red rail rifle and a single scope eye.
quip: Never misses. Sometimes forgets to shoot.

name: Bruiser
look: Boxer android with huge orange piston gloves.
quip: Floats like a brick.

name: Kunai
look: Ninja android throwing glowing violet kunai.
quip: Silent. Except the kunai.

name: Paladin
look: Knight android with a glowing pale-gold halberd.
quip: Polishes the armour between turns.

name: Falcon
look: Sleek mechanical falcon with sky-blue jet wings.
quip: Fast. Smug about it.

name: Smilodon
look: Mechanical sabre-tooth cat with long golden fangs.
quip: Built for the ice age. Wrong era.

name: Octopod
look: Mechanical octopus with eight hot-pink neon arms.
quip: Eight arms, all busy.

name: Bison
look: Armoured mechanical bison with bronze plating.
quip: Takes the scenic route. Through walls.

name: Drillbot
look: Stocky mining mech with a giant yellow drill arm.
quip: Loves boring work.

name: Gunship
look: Small attack-copter mech with green rotor lights.
quip: Hovers. Judges. Shoots.

name: Tankette
look: Tiny olive-green tank mech with an oversized cannon.
quip: Small. Loud. Proud.

name: Pulsar
look: Laser turret mech on walking legs, violet beam core.
quip: Has one move. It's a good one.

name: Runesmith
look: Android carving glowing orange runes into the air with a chisel.
quip: Writes in a font only he can read.

name: Stormcaller
look: Android mage holding a staff that crackles with blue lightning.
quip: Forecast: you, getting hit.

name: Shade
look: Shadow-mage android in robes of drifting purple smoke.
quip: Prefers the dark. Bad with stairs.

name: Alchemist
look: Android chemist with a bandolier of glowing lime potions.
quip: Ninety percent sure that one is safe.

name: Nightowl
look: Owl made of amber starlight with glowing moon eyes.
quip: Stays up late. Every night.

name: Dreamjelly
look: Floating jellyfish of soft pink light trailing glowing tendrils.
quip: Floats through life. Literally.

name: Wavesprite
look: Little water spirit riding a curling wave of cyan light.
quip: Always making waves.

name: Ashwolf
look: Wolf made of glowing embers and drifting ash.
quip: All bark. Also a lot of bite.

name: Cauldron
look: Bubbling cauldron construct on iron legs, glowing green brew.
quip: Soup of the day: you, but better.

name: Prismheart
look: Floating prism-crystal construct splitting light into rainbows.
quip: Sees every side of you.

name: Orrery
look: Brass orrery construct with glowing planets circling it.
quip: Knows where every planet is. Not the remote.

name: Moss
look: Mossy stone golem construct sprouting glowing green ferns.
quip: Slow to anger. Slow to everything.
